## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge on J winner days by trading SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK setups with specific volume, body, and confirmation parameters. The edge exists because the sniper setup is designed to break out of levels with institutional confirmation, and the refined parameters aim to improve winner capture while avoiding losers through stricter entry filters.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Trigger when:
- Volume >= vol_mult (1.1) x 20-bar average volume
- Candle body >= body_min_cents ($0.02)
- At least min_stars (2) confirmation signals (e.g., level break, ribbon flip, confluence)
- Strike set at strike_offset (2) OTM puts (assuming bearish bias per J anchors)
- Require break above open (true) to avoid false breakdowns

**Exit:**
- TP1: exit tp1_qty_fraction (0.667) of position when premium >= tp1_premium_pct (0.40) x entry premium
- Runner: remaining position trails with profit_lock_stop_offset_pct (0.08) x high-water mark once profit_lock_threshold_pct (0.0) is breached (effectively immediate trailing stop)
- Catastrophe premium stop: premium_stop_pct (-0.06) x entry premium
- Runner target: runner_target_pct (3.0) may serve as additional runner exit trigger (exact meaning requires code review)
- Time stop: 15:50 ET
